summary: Security-fix verification + regression. Backend: 16 tests in test_iteration14_security.py -> 14 pass, 1 xfail (infra), 1 FAIL (login IP throttle). CORS exact-origin allowlist OK (evil.preview origin gets no ACAO, own origin echoed with credentials), security headers OK, 415 for text/plain, form-urlencoded and multipart OK, register no longer enumerates, /api/stats has no users key, admin login OK, AI quota doc in ai_usage incremented by exactly 1 per call, account deletion wipes resumes/saved_jobs/interview_sessions/interview_preps/ai_usage/users, cron 200 (401 with bad secret). Frontend: login -> /dashboard with progress-card + saved jobs, reload keeps session, /jobs bookmark toggles (POST/DELETE 200), cover-letter dialog opens, logout -> /login and /auth/me 401. All frontend flows 100%.

critical.issue: Per-IP+email throttle (5) does not trigger reliably: 6th wrong password returns 401, not 429. RCA: ip = request.client.host is the ingress pod IP, and the preview has several ingress pods (seen in login_attempts: '10.219.5.134:<email>' count 4, '10.30.130.133:<email>' count 2), so the count is split across keys. Only the acct:<email> limit (20) ends up working. Fix: take the client IP from X-Forwarded-For (the entry the trusted proxy adds, not one the client can set) or X-Real-IP, then fall back to request.client.host.

minor.issue: Bodyless state-changing requests skip the Content-Type check because of the content-length==0 exemption. Reproduced: POST /api/saved/programs/{id} with Content-Type x-www-form-urlencoded and an empty body plus the session cookie -> 200 (a cross-site <form> with no inputs does the same). Affects POST /events/{id}/rsvp, POST /saved/programs/{id}, POST /auth/logout, POST /me/closing-soon-digest/preview. SameSite=Lax would block this in production, but in preview the ingress rewrites cookies to SameSite=None (see below), so the middleware is the only defence there. Suggest: also require a custom header (e.g. X-Requested-With) or check that Origin/Referer is in the allowlist for unsafe methods.

The backend sends SameSite=lax (checked on localhost:8001), but the public preview URL returns 'SameSite=None; Partitioned' because the Emergent/Cloudflare ingress rewrites it. Infra behaviour, not a code bug. Check the production domain separately.

The quota is used up before the LLM call, so 502 failures still count. A per-account lockout of 20 also lets anyone lock out any known email (including the admin) for 15 minutes. These are accepted trade-offs, listed here for awareness.
The content-type check is case-sensitive: 'Application/JSON' would be rejected. Very minor.
